title: MagicPhone
description: This is a simple Phone plugin.
body:
MagicPhone is a lightweight Paper Minecraft plugin that adds a fully interactive smartphone experience to your server.
Players can open a virtual phone with apps, menus, and future expansions, bringing modern gameplay mechanics into Minecraft
in a clean and fun way.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📱 Core Apps

📂 Phone Menu
Open the MagicPhone interface and access all installed apps from one clean GUI.

🛒 Store App
Download and unlock new apps directly from the in-game phone store.

🎨 Themes App
Customize the look of your phone by selecting different color themes.

🗺 Map App
Quickly access navigation-style features through a clean GUI.

🏦 Bank App (Vault)
View your balance and manage money using Vault-compatible economy plugins.
- Check balance
- Send money to other players
- No daily rewards

🧮 Calculator App
A simple calculator supporting:
+ Addition
- Subtraction
* Multiplication
/ Division

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🚀 Features

- Modern phone-style GUI inside Minecraft
- App-based system with an in-game store
- Vault economy support
- Custom phone item with resource pack support
- Lightweight and optimized
- Made for Paper servers

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📦 Installation

1. Place the plugin JAR in the plugins folder
2. Restart the server
3. Use /givephone (OP only) to receive the MagicPhone

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

💡 Compatibility

✔ Paper 1.21.11
✔ Vault-compatible economy plugins

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

💬 Feedback

Bug reports and app ideas are welcome.
This plugin is designed to be expandable with future apps.
